name: Rudolf Hess
source: A German politician, and Deputy Führer to Adolf Hitler in 1933. Hess always looks for the most reasonable solution and is driven by his love for the German people rather than a desire to plunge the world into war. He is turned into an anime girl after being assassinated by Claus von Stauffenberg.
